about: Fortnite build pieces (build mode, key G). Pieces snap to a world grid of match.buildTile blocks across and match.buildHeight blocks high. slot: the number key that picks the piece while building (1-3). wall: on the edge of your tile that you face; floor: one tile, under your feet level, in front of you (or under you when looking down); ramp: the tile in front, rising the way you face. cost: materials of the selected kind per piece. Left mouse places, right mouse switches Wood / Brick / Metal. Pieces only fill air (and grass/flowers); guns damage them (materials.pieceHealth); the pickaxe breaks a whole piece. All built pieces disappear when the match ends.
